snippet.title: Project Blue Files: Classified - Demo Announcement
snippet.description:
Project Blue Files: Classified Demo Announcement 
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4358700/Project_Blue_Files_Classified/

PROJECT BLUE FILES: CLASSIFIED is a first-person horror game inspired by declassified cases from the program. You step into the role of a witness, exploring isolated locations, examining evidence, and surviving encounters tied to unexplained events that were officially documented - but never fully explained…
